concern: ان لوگوں ("un logon", the disbelievers already referred to as "un" at 42:6 "un par nigraan hai") is rendered "in logon" at the start of this verse; the identical phrase is correctly "un logon" at 42:42.
suggestion: Kya un logon ne Allah Taala ke siwa aur karsaz bana liye hain

concern: ان لوگوں is rendered "In logon" at the start of this verse, but the same referent later in the very same verse is correctly "un ka faisla" and "un ke baad".
suggestion: Un logon ne apne paas ilm aa jaane ke baad hi ikhtilaaf kiya

concern: ان لوگوں is rendered "Kya in logon ne" at the start of this verse, but the same referent later in the very same verse is correctly "un mein faisla" and "(un) zaalimon".
suggestion: Kya un logon ne aise (Allah ke) shareek (muqarrar kar rakhe) hain
